column1: # Tab5 OS flash layout (16 MB). Offsets are fixed from Phase 0: never move them
# or A/B updates and recovery stop working on deployed units.
# Partition table at 0x10000 (not the IDF default 0x8000) so the bootloader
# has 56 KB for the Phase 9 recovery hook and secure boot.
# Recovery image (Phase 9). Subtype "test" so the bootloader never picks it by
# default and `idf.py flash` writes the OS to ota_0. Phase 9 adds the
# bootloader hook that enters it after three failed boots.
# Image used to update the ESP32-C6 radio (Phase 3).

column2: LittleFS (Phase 1.8). Runs to the end of flash.
